summary: ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.38 per share, payable July 10, 2026, to holders of record July 1, 2026. The board declared the dividend at a meeting on June 15, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation event. No deal terms, premiums, or structural changes are present.
